dhp167:4:
lokavaddhano → hīnaṃ dharmaṃ na seveta pramādena na saṃvaset 
mithyādṛṣṭiṃ na seveta na bhavellākavaṭhinaඃ (udānavarga 4. 5. 8.) 
hina dhama na sevea pramadena na savasi 
michā diṭhi na royea na sia lokavaḍhano. (prā. dha. A. 8 6)
dhp168:4:
ca → uttiṣṭhenana pramadyona dharmaṃ sucaritaṃ caret. 
dharmacārī sukhaṃ śete hyasmin loke paratra ca. (udānavarga 4. 5. 35) 
utiṭhena na pramajea dhamu sucarita cari. 
dhamavari suhu śeti asam loki parasa yi. (prā. dha. A 8 6)
dhp169:4:
ca → dharma caret sucaritaṃ nainaṃ duścaritaṃ caret 
dharmacārī sukhaṃ śete asmiṃlelāke paratra ca (mahāvastu 1 220 piṭa) 
dhamu cari sucarita............ carita cari. 
dhamayari subha śeti asmi loki parasa yi. (prā. dha. C. 30)
dhp172:4:
candimā → yo tu puci pramajati paja su na pramajati. 
so ina lokū obhāsetī abhamuto va suriu (prā, dha. A 2 3)
